name: media-manager
description: Media Manager - Physical media collection management with storage tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:clients"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run generate:clients
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.validate:clients: npm run validate:typescript && npm run validate:python && npm run validate:mock
scripts.validate:python: cd generated/python-client && python -m pip install -e . && python -c 'import media_manager_client; print("Python client validation successful")'
scripts.clean: npm run clean:generated && npm run clean:build
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:tools
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && python -m flake8 app/ && python -m black --check app/
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend

author: trekie86
